newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher, exports lift July.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher, exports lift July.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled higher, with July gaining at the close on pricing related to export business, traders said.
Traders said global trading firm Bunge, whose parent company is based in Sao Paulo, Brazil, bought one million July bushels late.
"They were pricing some export business. It was done in the last 1/2 hour of trade," a MGE floor source said of Bunge's activity.
MGE spring wheat settled 3/4 to 2-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with May up 3/4 cent at $4.33-1/4. July gained 2-1/2 cents to close at $4.35-1/2.
Apart from the late firmness, it had been a choppy, two-sided session as spring wheat values flip-flopped above and below Monday's close.
Other players besides Bunge included Benson-Quinn, which bull-spread 1.4 million May/July bushels at 1-1/2 to 2-1/2 cents, traders said.
